title: WaterColor 478 East Royal Fern
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Private Heated Pool and Sitting Spa **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $60 per day**- 4 adult bikes- Fireplace- SONOS sound system- Second-floor screened-in porch with a ping pong table- Professionally decorated- Gourmet kitchen- This property comes with 3 dedicated parking spots. Additional parking can be found throughout the community- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Your Emerald Coast getaway starts here! 478 East Royal Fern Drive is an incredible WaterColor home offering 4 gorgeous bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, a private pool and spacious outdoor living area, and beautiful accommodations for 12 guests! White shiplap walls and large transom windows throughout the main level amplify the natural light for a bright and airy feel. This level boasts an open-concept floorplan connecting the main living, dining, and kitchen spaces. The foodies and cooks in your group will undoubtedly adore the spacious kitchen, which boasts bright white countertops and cabinetry, a large gas range, premium stainless-steel appliances, and a wine refrigerator. For mealtimes, guests can utilize 4 seats at the kitchen island or ample seating at the nearby dining table. The luxurious living room offers two plush sofas, two armchairs, mounted flat-screen television and soundbar for the ultimate at-home movie night. This level also showcases the beautiful primary suite, offering an upholstered king bed and a private bathroom with a soaking tub, a glass-front shower, and a dual-sink vanity. On the second floor are three stunning king bed guestrooms - each featuring a private bathroom with a shower - and a bunk area with two sets of built-in twin-over-twin bunk beds.Gorgeous outdoor spaces await, including a second-floor sitting porch, a screened porch with a ping pong table, and the incredible backyard oasis. Under a large covered porch is the large outdoor dining table - perfect spot for enjoying dinners al fresco - and the outdoor living area. The expansive pool deck and lounge chairs surround a sparkling pool (which can be heated seasonally for an additional fee) and bubbling spa.Guests in this home can enjoy a breezy ride on the home's four custom 360 Blue adult Beach cruiser bikes, which are perfect for exploring the beautiful scenery of WaterColor. Guests will also enjoy the home's convenient location just minutes from Publix and the best local dining, shopping, and entertainment along 30A! When it's time for fun and sun, utilize the home's access to the recently renovated Camp WaterColor or pack up to enjoy a day at the beach, listening to the peaceful sounds of EmeraldCoast waves crashing on the sugar-white sand. Plan your WaterColor getaway at 478 East Royal Fern Drive today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubSECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyBunk Area: Two Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout.Unfortunately, this home does not allow pets at any time.
